vignette: A child with compromised immunity received antibiotic prophylaxis before an invasive dental procedure. Two days later the parent reports fever, malaise, and lethargy.
stem: What is the most appropriate interpretation and response?

options.text: The symptoms may signal antibiotic failure, so arrange further medical evaluation.
Prophylaxis completely prevents infection, so the symptoms must be unrelated and need no follow-up.
Treat the symptoms as expected after a procedure and advise no evaluation.
Plan to give clindamycin prophylaxis before the next procedure to prevent a recurrence.
